Interface TaskRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<Task,UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Task,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<Task,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<Task,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<Task,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<Task>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Task,UUID>
public interface TaskRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Task,UUID>
The user's tasks, newest first: all of them, those matching a search, and how many have each status.

Hamza Rasool, Abdullah Khan

  • Method Details

    • findAllByOrderByCreatedAtDesc

      List<Task> findAllByOrderByCreatedAtDesc()
      Every task, the one added last first.
      Returns:
      the tasks, newest first; empty when there are none

    • search

      @Query("select task from Task task\nwhere (:status is null or task.status = :status)\n and (lower(task.title) like :pattern escape '!' or lower(task.description) like :pattern escape '!')\norder by task.createdAt desc\n") List<Task> search(@Param("pattern") String pattern, @Param("status") @Nullable TaskStatus status)
      The tasks whose title or description matches the pattern, whatever its case, in one status or in all.
      Parameters:
      pattern - a like pattern in lower case, such as %report%, with any %, _ or ! meant literally escaped by !
      status - the one status to list, or null for every status
      Returns:
      the matching tasks, newest first; empty when none match

    • countByStatus

      long countByStatus(TaskStatus status)
      How many tasks have the status.
      Parameters:
      status - the status to count
      Returns:
      the number of tasks in it; 0 when there are none
